A stay you’ll want to last forever

Explore

Cozy Self-Catering accommodations for holiday makers, located in Belombre, Mahe, Seychelles.

Featuring two distinct categories of accommodation:
TWO-BEDROOM SEASIDE APARTMENT
(Suitable for 4 adults maximum)
STUDIO APARTMENTS
(Suitable for 2 adults — sofa-bed available for children)

Located in a safe, quiet neighborhood with immediate access to local shops, the church, and bus stops. The property is fully secured by a perimeter wall and electric gate. Guests enjoy exclusive access to the family pool and a dedicated path to snorkeling-friendly beach areas just steps away. As a family-run business, we are always nearby to ensure your stay is perfect.

Book Two-Bedroom Apartment
Book Studio Apartment
Why Choose Us

Thoughtful stays with the ocean just steps away.

Seaside Location

Wake up to the sound of the ocean and walk to the beach in moments.

Relaxed Amenities

Pool access, daily cleaning, and all the essentials to keep things easy.

Everything Nearby

Shops, restaurants, and transport are just a short walk away.

Guest Reviews

Trusted by guests who stay with us.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.

Each villa at Takamaka House is fully self-catering — a complete home on the water's edge, with everything arranged before you arrive. Our small team is always close by, but never intrusive.

Rates include airport transfers from Mahé International, a welcome hamper of local produce from Victoria Market, and a curated guide to the south of the island written by our family.

REQUEST A BOOKING →
Airport Transfer

Complimentary collection from Seychelles International Airport on Mahé. Private vehicle, no shared shuttles.

Boat Trips

Arrange day charters to Ile Souris, Grand Fond, and the coral reefs of Ste. Anne Marine Park through our local captain.

Concierge Service

Restaurant reservations, activity bookings, car hire, and local knowledge. Our team handles it all.

Private & Secure

Fully gated property. Each villa has its own entrance and private outdoor space. Neighbouring villas are never in view.

Welcome Hamper

Fresh tropical fruit, Seychelles vanilla, local spices, and a bottle of Takamaka rum waiting on arrival.

Fully Equipped

Full kitchen, washer, air conditioning, beach towels, snorkel gear, and high-speed WiFi throughout the property.

Chef on Request

Arrange a private Creole dinner or Sunday brunch prepared at your villa by our local chef, Joelle.

Long Stay Rates

Weekly and monthly rates available for extended stays. Contact us for bespoke pricing.

ANSE TAKAMAKA · SOUTH MAHÉ
THE LOCATION
South Mahé's
hidden quarter.

Anse Takamaka sits on the quieter, wilder south coast of Mahé — away from the resort strip, facing open Indian Ocean. The beach takes its name from the takamaka tree whose enormous roots hold the granite boulders in place at the water's edge.

Victoria, the capital, is a 35-minute drive through the Morne Seychellois National Park — a journey that passes vanilla plantations, cinnamon forests, and the island's only rum distillery, La Plaine St. André.

65
BEACHES ON MAHÉ
25°C
YEAR-ROUND AVG.
45 min
FROM AIRPORT
115
ISLANDS, ARCHIPELAGO
EXPLORE THE AREA →
GUEST EXPERIENCES
In their
own words.
"

We stayed in Lagon Bleu for ten nights. The beach at Anse Takamaka had not a single sun lounger, not a single beach vendor. Just the granite boulders, the turtles, and us.

Sophie & Marc Renault
Lyon, France · March 2024
★
★
★
★
★
"

Anita arranged everything — the boat to Ste. Anne, dinner at Marie Antoinette in Victoria, a morning at Morne. All we did was say yes. This is how a holiday should feel.

James & Priya Whitmore
London, UK · January 2024
★
★
★
★
★
"

Coco Vert was perfect for our honeymoon. The welcome hamper had a handwritten note from the family, Takamaka rum, and fresh lemongrass from the garden. We cried, a little.

Lea & Daniel Fischer
Zürich, Switzerland · December 2023
★
★
★
★
★
FROM YOUR DOORSTEP
The island,
at your pace.
🤿
Snorkelling

Granite reef 50 metres from the shore. Sea turtles are frequent guests.

⛵
Island Hopping

Day charters to Curieuse, Cousin, and the Vallée de Mai on Praslin.

🥾
Forest Trails

Morne Seychellois National Park — cinnamon, vanilla, and Black Paradise Flycatchers.

🎣
Deep Sea Fishing

Half and full-day charters with Captain Serge. Wahoo, dorado, sailfish.

🍽️
Creole Dining

La Sirène, Kaz Kreol, and Marie Antoinette — Victoria's best Creole tables, reserved for you.

What we do,
and how we do it.

Each project begins not with a brief, but with a conversation. We need to understand how you inhabit a space before we can imagine how you might inhabit it differently. Our four disciplines work as one continuous practice.

01
Residential Design

Full-scope interior architecture for private homes and apartments. From initial concept through material specification to project completion oversight.

LEARN MORE →
02
Commercial Spaces

Boutique hospitality, professional studios, and brand environments. Spatial design that works as hard commercially as it does aesthetically.

LEARN MORE →
03
Design Consultancy

Strategic input for clients facing significant material, spatial, or aesthetic decisions. Available as standalone engagements — no full project required.

LEARN MORE →
04
Project Coordination

Construction and contractor liaison. Managing the space between design intent and physical reality — protecting the vision through to delivery.

LEARN MORE →
THE STUDIO
A practice built on
quiet conviction.

Forma Studio was founded in 2009 by Luca Ferrara and Elise Hartmann — two architects who shared a single conviction: that the most enduring spaces are those that hold their restraint. Fourteen years on, that conviction has shaped over sixty completed projects across Europe.

We are a practice of eight. Small enough that every project receives its principal's full attention. Large enough to carry complex commissions from conception to completion without diminishing the idea that started them.

MEET THE STUDIO →
14
YEARS PRACTICE
63
PROJECTS COMPLETED
12
COUNTRIES

"A project begins with a conversation. Not a brief. We want to understand how you live before we consider how you might live differently."

LUCA FERRARA, FOUNDING PRINCIPAL
HOW WE WORK
From first conversation
to final detail.
01
Discovery

An unhurried conversation about how you live, what matters to you, and what the space is for.

02
Concept

Spatial and material proposals. We present one strong direction — not three hedged options.

03
Development

Technical drawings, material boards, and full specification. Every decision documented before a single wall is touched.

04
Construction

On-site oversight and contractor coordination throughout. The design doesn't end at handover — it begins there.

05
Handover

A final walkthrough. A maintenance guide. And an open door — we remain available to every client, indefinitely.

START YOUR PROJECT

begin?

We take on a limited number of projects each year. Enquire early.
